description: Non-Material Amendment to planning permission reference 222417 granted 12th April 2023 to allow for an amendment to the description of the development as set out in the 12th April 2023 decision notice to read as follows:  “Redevelopment of the site involving the demolition of existing structures/building and the construction of a mixed-use building (over basement) to provide a new music/cultural venue (sui generis ), bar (sui generis), commercial unit (Use Class E) and shared co-living accommodation with associated internal and external amenity space (sui generis) together with ancillary refuse/cycle stores, servicing areas, landscaping, public realm works and disabled car parking”
